review.verdict: Fails: the cast and basic staging are legible, but the spokesperson's "cheer" pose undercuts the human-shield metaphor, the reporter's arm/bubble is pushed outside the safe area, a prop overlaps awkwardly, and the palette/composition is too close to a recent slopper.
revisionNotes: Spokesperson's "cheer" pose (arms raised overhead) reads as celebrating, not shielding — switch to a forward-block pose, arms raised in front at chest/eye height, so the blank bubble sits visually between him and the reporter and the human-shield metaphor actually lands.

Reporter's point pose sends his arm off the right edge into empty space; lint confirms he extends outside the safe area (x 743…1066). Re-anchor reporter to x≈0.80 and change pose to something reactive (surprised, hands up) instead of pointing off-canvas.
Executive's extended arm crosses directly through the hazard triangle/meter top — shift the meter ~40px right or drop the executive's pose to something that doesn't collide with it.
Reporter's book prop sits flat on his torso like a sticker rather than being held — offset it forward/down into his hands and tilt it slightly so it reads as a held notepad.

Palette (teal ground, cream sky, orange accent, split horizon) closely echoes the recent "CALM" slopper's background and color scheme — swap to a different background type or color pairing for more separation.

All three figures share the same stiff horizontal arm silhouette, making the trio look like one rig repeated three times — vary arm height/angle per character so point, shield, and react are visually distinct beats.

review.verdict: Clean paper-cutout rendering with a fair, human-only cast, but the joke's key device—the blank bubble literally blocking the reporter's question—never visually happens, the spokesperson's arm overlaps the reporter oddly, and the palette closely repeats a recent piece; falls short of the bar.
revisionNotes: Overlap the shield-bubble onto the reporter-bubble so the blank bubble visibly blocks the '?' — right now they sit side by side with no occlusion, so the central 'human shield' metaphor never reads.
Shorten/reposition the spokesperson's right arm (pose 'shrug') — it currently stretches across the frame to touch the reporter's hand, reading like a handshake instead of a blocking gesture.
Scale the reporter up closer to 0.85–0.9 so it reads as an adult journalist rather than a child next to the executive and spokesperson.
Redesign the podium silhouette (narrower top panel, visible front face) so it reads clearly as a lectern rather than an ambiguous pedestal or cone.
Swap the tan/kraft-and-teal palette for a different ground/background combo — it closely echoes the recent slopper with the same thermometer, tan sky, and teal ground.
Tighten vertical spacing or enlarge the group slightly to use more of the square; there's a lot of dead sky above the figures.

review.verdict: The human-shield metaphor collapses because the blank speech bubble appears to belong to the reporter rather than being held up by the spokesperson, and the podium renders as an unreadable blob — the joke doesn't land without a close, puzzled look. Fails the bar; needs the bubble reattached to the spokesperson and the podium redrawn.
revisionNotes: The shield-bubble renders stacked on the reporter's head/notepad instead of above the spokesperson's raised arms — the core 'human shield' metaphor doesn't read. Pull the bubble's offset back toward the spokesperson anchor (closer to x=0.60-0.65) so it visibly comes from them.

Spokesperson's pose is 'shrug' with holds 'none', so nothing in the figure's body language connects to the bubble above. Change pose to a raised-arm 'raise' or set holds to the bubble so the shield looks held, not floating.
The podium under the executive renders as an unreadable white trapezoid, not a lectern — redraw the raw podium shape with a visible front panel so it's identifiable as a podium at a glance.
Reporter's notepad is mostly hidden behind the bubble stack and only a sliver is visible bottom-right; reposition its offset clear of the bubble cluster and bump scale to ~0.9.
The right-third (reporter + two speech bubbles + notepad) is crowded and overlapping; separate the '?' bubble and shield bubble vertically, or reduce shield-bubble scale to ~1.0 to cut the clutter.
Palette and staging (kraft background, teal ground band, single red/orange meter accent, cutout figure) closely echo a recent piece — vary the floor color or background treatment to stand apart.
